question: Related Questions Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 58311 Country: Pakistan Title: Exchange of Mobile Question: Recently, I exchanged my mobile with an unknown person's mobile phone. But I lied him that my mobile's battery timing is more than a day but actually its battery timing was not good. But that person also lied me that his mobile is working properly and in good condition but actually it's WIFI signals catching power was very weak and there was also a brown mark on his mobile phone screen. I have downloaded many Islamic books and Quran apps in his mobile phone. My question is that is it permissible for me to read and gain Islamic knowledge from these books that I downloaded on his mobile as I got this mobile by telling a lie? Answer ID: 58311 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 348/348/SD=07/1436) As per the question mentioned above, it is lawful to read the downloaded books and the Holy Quran in the said mobile, but you must do taubah and istighfar for telling a lie and cheating. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
